Who May Apply: US Citizens This is a Direct Hire Authority (DHA) solicitation utilizing the DHA for Certain Personnel of the DoD Workforce to recruit and appoint qualified candidates to positions in the competitive service. In order to qualify, you must meet the experience requirements described below.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student; social). You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Your resume must clearly describe your relevant experience; if qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application. Additional information about transcripts is in this document.

Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience which includes 1.) managing Automated Information Systems projects, including defining project scope, monitoring project activities, and coordinating milestones to meet project objectives; 2.) providing technical support for information systems by analyzing user needs, recommending technology solutions, and assisting in the design and development of customized system configurations; 3.) developing project plans and statements of work (SOWs), and participating in the review of deliverables for completeness and accuracy in support of enterprise-wide initiatives; AND 4.) supporting cybersecurity processes by assisting with control reviews within the Risk Management Framework (RMF) to ensure information systems remain compliant with security standards.

This definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the next lower grade/level position in the federal service (GS-12). Some federal jobs allow you to substitute your education for the required experience in order to qualify.

For this job, you must meet the qualification requirement using experience alone--no substitution of education for experience is permitted.

The initial application review cut-off for this job announcement is 50 applications. The first 50 applications received will be considered first. Applications received after the initial cut-off number (50 applications) may not receive consideration unless otherwise requested by management.

If management requests additional certificates, applicants will continue to be reviewed in groups of 50 in the order they applied. Note: Submitting multiple applications will change the order in which your application is reviewed.

Major Duties: Initiates and manages IT projects as well as special technical studies related to executing the EHRM-IO mission.

Projects cover a wide area of scope within EHRM workstreams including but not limited to deployments, new/enhanced solutions and capabilities/integrations, transition to sustainment projects, technical operations, domain operations, infrastructure.

Coordinates and/or conducts presentations in long range and annual work planning and IT capabilities to advise on the proposed formulation, management and execution of program resources (personnel and funding) and other management matters through an understanding of requirements and policies based on capabilities and resources.

Evaluates, monitors, or ensures compliance with Federal, VA laws and regulations, policies, standards, or procedures; Identifies standards or requirements for infrastructure, technical configuration or technical change management, Section 508 Accessibility compliance.

Promotion Potential: The selectee may be promoted to the full performance level without further competition when all regulatory, qualification, and performance requirements are met. Selection at a lower grade level does not guarantee promotion to the full performance level.

Work Schedule: Monday-Friday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm Compressed/Flexible: Yes Telework: This position may be authorized for telework. Telework eligibility will be discussed during the interview process. Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Position Description Title/PD#: It Project Manager/PD20983A Physical Requirements: The work is sedentary.

Some work will require walking and standing in conjunction with travel and attendance at meetings and conferences away from the work site. Some employees may carry light items, such as papers, books, or small parts. The work does not require any special physical effort. Work may require occasional travel.
To qualify for this position, applicants must meet all requirements by the closing date of this announcement, 08/25/2026. Applicants must meet the requirements of the competency-based qualification standard to be fully qualified. NOTE: The basic requirements MUST be substantiated in your resume.

Failure to provide the required information will render your application ineligible for consideration. For all positions, individuals must meet or exceed the minimum proficiency level established for each of the nine competencies listed below.

The employing agency is responsible for identifying the specific level of proficiency required for each competency at each grade level based on the requirements of the position being filled.

For the GS-11: To meet the Competency-Based Qualification Standard for the Information Technology (IT) Management Series (2210), you must possess: Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

Interpersonal Skills - Shows understanding, friendliness, courtesy, tact, empathy, concern, and politeness to others; develops and maintains effective relationships with others; may include effectively dealing with individuals who are difficult, hostile, or distressed; relates well to people from varied backgrounds and different situations.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations. Teamwork - Encourages and facilitates cooperation, pride, trust, and group identity; fosters commitment and team spirit; works with others to achieve goals.

Technical Competence - Uses knowledge that is acquired through formal training or on-the-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job; advises others on technical issues.

AND Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped the applicant with the particular competencies/knowledge, skills, and abilities to successfully perform the duties of the position and is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled.

Such experience is typically gained in the IT field or through the performance of work where the primary concern is IT. GS-11 Specialized experience: You must possess one-year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-9 level.

Specialized experience is defined as applying analytical methods and practices sufficient to conduct analyses and recommend resolution of complex issues affecting the Electronic Health Record (EHR) deployment and remediation of high risk IT processes related to program control and management.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religions; spiritual; community; student; social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

For more information on these qualification standards, please visit the United States Office of Personnel Management's website at https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/.

Hey there!
We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.
Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.
Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?
To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!
Ready to be part of the experience?
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.
Team context
User Operations sits within Fever's broader User Support organization. User Operations is the strategic/enablement layer behind the operating User support structure, organized around three areas: AI integration, Systems, and Data.
Within Data, we focus on continuous improvement. We don't just maintain information that's useful and relevant to stakeholders inside and outside the department, we translate that data into concrete initiatives that let us keep questioning and improving how we work.

We're looking for a Project Manager with a strong analytics backbone. This isn't a "build the dashboard and move on", we need someone who can go from constructing the data (dashboards, reporting, automations) to understanding what it actually means for the business, so they can help management make consistently data-driven decisions.
Projects will range from a variety of stakeholders, such as, providing user support with operating actionable metrics, giving partners visibility into how their events are performing or helping on app developments that directly shape the user experience.

Analytics (70% weight)
2-4 years of experience in data/analytics (analyst, data PM, BI, ops analytics). A relevant Master's or further training in the field is a plus.
Comfortable building and maintaining dashboards in tools like Metabase, Looker, or similar.
Scripting/automation experience.
Project management & structure (30% weight)
Demonstrated ability to run a project end-to-end.
Organized, structured, and comfortable prioritizing your own workload.
You default to improving things, not just maintaining them. When you spot something inefficient, you fix it or raise it, you don't leave it for later.
Comfortable communicating with both technical (central Data team) and non-technical (support ops) stakeholders.
Not required today, but a plus: some early signs of enjoying explaining things to others or helping people grow. This role is expected to evolve into managing a team member over time, no prior people-management experience needed.
Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!
If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu | TechCrunch

Job Title: Senior Clinical Project Manager, Oncology, IQVIA Biotech
Job Location: Kirkland, Quebec, Canada
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time

IQVIA Biotech is a full-service CRO purpose-built to serve biotech sponsors. With over 25 years of experience, we offer agile, therapeutically aligned solutions and trusted partnerships that help bring breakthrough treatments to patients faster.
We are seeking a Senior Clinical Project Manager with proven experience in Oncologyclinical trials to join IQVIA Biotech. This role is ideal for a seasoned project management professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about advancing therapies in the Immuno-Oncology space. You will leverage your expertise to lead complex, multi-regional studies and ensure operational excellence while building strong client relationships.

As a Senior Clinical Project Manager at IQVIA Biotech, you’ll play a critical role in accelerating the delivery of clinical trials and improving patient lives by bringing new therapies to market faster. You will lead core project teams, ensuring successful execution of clinical studies in alignment with contractual requirements, SOPs, and regulatory standards. This role combines strategic leadership, operational excellence, and customer engagement to deliver high-quality results.

Lead bid defense presentations and contribute to study strategy development.
Develop and implement integrated study management plans.
Oversee planning and execution of medium to large, multi-regional clinical studies, ensuring speed, quality, and cost optimization.
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, fostering strong relationships and customer satisfaction.
Build and lead cross-functional teams, driving collaboration and milestone achievement.
Monitor project progress, manage risks, and resolve issues proactively.
Ensure compliance with ICH GCP, local regulations, and company processes.
Manage project financials, including forecasting, scope changes, and revenue acceleration opportunities.
Mentor and support team members, promoting continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or related field.
7+ years of clinical research experience, including 4+ years in project management.
Strong knowledge of clinical trial conduct, regulatory requirements, and therapeutic areas.
Excellent leadership, communication, and negotiation skills.
Proven ability to manage complex projects across geographies and functions.
Proficiency in MS Office and project management tools.

### Job description ###
**Location**: Zurich

**Help our clients successfully manage global challenges**
Our Swiss market-leading FSI Deal Transformation and Post-Merger Integration Team advises Swiss Corporate and mid-market clients to generate and create value from their Mergers & Acquisitions, Divestitures, and Carve-outs. With a dedicated team of FSI experts, we deliver integration and separation advisory services, leading complex engagements with our clients, and deploying deep functional expertise in finance, human resources, commercial, and technology.
At Deloitte, we support our clients on end-to-end M&A advisory, working closely with our colleagues from transaction services, valuations, and corporate finance. As part of the Strategy, Risk and Transactions Business Line, we further collaborate with our Strategy, Sustainability, Regulatory and Forensics and Technology peers to ensure a seamless and value-driven approach to transactions.
**How you will make an impact **
* M&A Integration and Separation leadership: bring a forward-looking approach and tailored methodologies to client situations, to lead complex M&A separations and integrations.
* M&A value creation: perform and oversee operational and financial analysis to assess synergies, the impact and complexities of carve-outs, and the stand-alone performance improvement potential of buyouts and corporate divestments.
* Exceptional client service: advise clients across Deloitte-s offerings, building and maintaining strong relationships, while leading the engagement teams to deliver exceptional client service, adhering to quality and robust methodology.
* C-suite intimacy: develop your ability to lead conversations with client CXOs, articulating ideas into tangible solutions, and becoming the client-s go-to contact for delivery transformation.
* Project scope and delivery: define, plan, resource, and execute project scope; manage expectations and timelines with clients, ensuring high-quality deliverables.
* Team leadership and development: inspire and guide team members to achieve their full potential, fostering a collaborative environment that encourages innovation and excellence in project execution.
* Analytical and AI solutions: provide strategic insights, advice and deploy advanced analytical and AI solutions.

* Demonstrated FSI experience, entrepreneurial mindset, self-starter attitude, highly motivated to lead and grow, with ability to work independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with tight deadlines and evolving priorities.
* Strong problem-solving capabilities with a focus on strategic decision-making and attention to detail, alongside a proven ability to simplify complex concepts, create executive-level narratives, and synthesise value effectively.
* Bachelor-s or Master-s degree from top-tier universities with exceptional academic marks.
* Minimum of 7 years of relevant M&A experience in consulting or industry roles, with clear experience in one of our main sectors, i.e., banking, wealth management, and insurance.
* Strong acumen for project and stakeholder management, with high-quality skills in Excel, PowerPoint and executive storytelling.
* Aptitude with AI technologies and a keen interest in embedding AI solutions into our offerings to enhance client outcomes and drive innovation.
* Fluent in English, with excellent interpersonal skills and experience working within an international community. Language proficiency in German is desired.
**Joining our team **
You-ll become part of a friendly, diverse, and highly motivated team. We will help you develop both personally and professionally through on-the-job learning, mentoring and high-quality trainings, but also through working with peers across diverse offering portfolios. At Deloitte, we are committed to a strong feedback culture, to ensure our talent is exposed to a wide and global professional environment and continuous learning.

At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact.
In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors.

We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn.
Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.apply.deloitte.ch

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

We're looking for a personal security program manager to support a fast-growing GSIS (Global Safety, Intelligence & Security) function.

Reporting to the Protective Service Senior Manager, and working within the broader direction the Protective Services Lead sets, this role sits at the intersection of corporate security fundamentals and program management execution.

You'll execute a defined slice of the policies, processes, and reporting that let the function scale, working within scope your manager sets rather than defining that scope yourself, and you'll support cross-functional projects of low to moderate complexity.
This is not a purely administrative role. You'll need enough security domain grounding to work credibly alongside experienced practitioners, enough program discipline to execute reliably against a defined plan, and enough judgment to know when to flag something up rather than push forward on your own. Most of what you touch will already have a framework your manager has set; your job is to execute cleanly within it and surface what needs a decision above your level.

Maintain the policy and procedure library for your assigned GSIS sub-domain, following the framework your manager sets, flagging gaps rather than resolving them unilaterally
Support the GSIS metrics and reporting framework for your assigned scope: pull together operational health and status updates on a defined cadence
Execute assigned tasks in the build-out of net-new capabilities, under close direction from the Senior Manager or Lead; contribute to documentation and training materials
Act as first point of contact for lower-complexity stakeholder requests within your assigned domain, resolving directly where the answer is clear and routing everything else up with context
Contribute to audit-ready documentation within your scope, following existing templates and standards
Support cross-functional GSIS projects of low to moderate complexity, owning specific workstreams within a project rather than the project's overall scope, timeline, or stakeholder communication

s.t:

Bring working familiarity with at least one or two GSIS domains, with the speed and willingness to build fluency in others

Care about Anthropic's mission and the unique security considerations that come with building frontier AI systems

We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

About Betterment
Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses.

Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease. We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/ week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).

The Business Systems & Tooling (BS&T) team builds and operates the internal systems that power Betterment's B2B businesses — from Salesforce and its surrounding integrations to the tooling that connects our sales, service, and advisor workflows to the Betterment platform itself.

Because Betterment sells across multiple lines of business, our sales tech stack has to reflect that complexity: it's not one product and one funnel, but a set of interconnected systems serving distinct teams with distinct needs.
This role owns the interface between BS&T and its stakeholders. You'll embed deeply within stakeholder teams — attending their meetings, learning their day-to-day workflows, and understanding their upcoming priorities — so that BS&T can proactively identify opportunities rather than waiting for problems to arrive as tickets.

You'll then bring that context back to the team, partnering with our engineering leads and architects to translate stakeholder needs into well-scoped tasks and clear, communicated roadmaps.
This role is ideal for someone who is energized by sitting between business teams and technical teams: fluent enough in each world to be trusted by both, and disciplined enough to turn ambiguity into a plan.
This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment's total compensation package for employees.
New York City: $125,000 – $145,000
This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus.
A Day in the Life
Stakeholder Immersion & Discovery
Embed with stakeholder teams across our lines of business, attending their regular meetings and building a working knowledge of their processes, tools, and pain points.
Proactively surface opportunities for tooling improvements, automation, and best practices — bringing ideas to stakeholders rather than waiting to be handed a problem.
Maintain a continuously updated view of each stakeholder group's upcoming priorities and how they map to BS&T's capacity and roadmap.
Act as the first point of contact for new stakeholder requests, gathering context and framing the underlying need before work is committed.
Scoping, Roadmapping & Prioritization
Partner with BS&T's engineering lead and architects to translate stakeholder needs into scoped, documented tasks with clear success criteria.
Own and communicate the BS&T roadmap, making prioritization decisions legible to stakeholders and aligning our planning rhythm with the rest of the company.
Balance urgent stakeholder priorities against high-value quality-of-life improvements, ensuring compounding wins don't get perpetually deferred.
Run intake, backlog grooming, and status communication processes so the team's work — and the reasoning behind it — is visible.
Vendor & Salestech Landscape
Stay current on the salestech landscape, evaluating emerging tools and practices for fit with Betterment's stack.
Support vendor assessments, procurement, and renewal processes across our salestech vendors, partnering with Finance, Legal, and Security as needed.
Help stakeholders evaluate build-vs-buy tradeoffs with a clear-eyed view of total cost, integration complexity, and maintenance burden.

5+ years of experience in product management, technical program management, business systems analysis, or a similar role sitting between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Working knowledge of Salesforce and the surrounding GTM systems ecosystem (e.g., CPQ workflows, enrichment, engagement, and integration tooling) — enough to scope work credibly and ask the right questions, even if you don't build in it yourself.
Experience at a company with a complex, multi-product go-to-market — where internal systems must integrate the CRM, adjacent salestech tools, and the product being sold itself.
Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous stakeholder requests into scoped, prioritized, well-documented work.
Experience supporting vendor evaluation, procurement, or renewal processes is a strong plus.

Proactive by default: identifies opportunities and proposes solutions rather than operating purely on intake.
Strong writer and documenter; believes that a decision isn't made until it's written down and shared.

Legal and Compliance manages all legal and regulatory matters, including privacy, contracts, corporate governance, compliance, employment law, intellectual property, government relations, and claims, while supporting Coursera's and Udemy's platforms and partnerships.

The Privacy Program Manager is responsible for operationalizing and scaling the company's global privacy program across products, platforms, and business functions.

Working closely with Legal, Security, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners, this role translates privacy and data protection requirements into scalable operational processes, governance, and technical controls that embed privacy by design across the organization.

The role owns core privacy operations, including privacy impact assessments, records of processing activities, vendor privacy reviews, and data subject rights requests, while driving automation, self-service capabilities, and continuous improvement to enable the business to meet privacy obligations efficiently at scale.

Lead and continuously improve core privacy program operations, including privacy impact assessments (DPIAs), records of processing activities (ROPAs), vendor privacy reviews, and privacy compliance workflows, using privacy management tools and workflow automation where appropriate.
Design, implement, and manage scalable processes for data subject rights requests and general privacy inquiries, partnering with Engineering and Support teams to improve efficiency while meeting regulatory deadlines.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Marketing, Procurement, and other stakeholders to conduct privacy reviews for new products, features, vendors, and business initiatives, embedding privacy by design into business processes.
Develop and maintain privacy policies, standards, operational guidance, training, records, and self-service resources that enable teams to manage routine privacy obligations independently, with clear escalation paths where appropriate.
Monitor changes in global privacy laws and regulations, translating legal requirements into practical operational processes, controls, and guidance.
Define and report on privacy program metrics, identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, and support initiatives related to incident response, data retention, cross-border data transfers, and broader privacy governance.

5+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, compliance, or a related program management function.
Demonstrated experience supporting a privacy program subject to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and one or more U.S. state privacy laws, such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), within a multinational or complex organization.
Demonstrated experience translating privacy and data protection requirements, including GDPR and CCPA, into operational processes, policies, controls, guidance, or technical requirements in partnership with Legal, Engineering, Product, and Security teams.
Experience conducting operational privacy activities, including DPIAs, maintaining ROPAs, managing data subject rights requests, vendor privacy reviews, privacy due diligence, and privacy contract reviews.
Experience implementing, administering, or optimizing a privacy management platform (such as OneTrust, TrustArc, or a comparable solution) to support privacy operations, workflow automation, and program governance.
Bachelor's degree (or equivalent practical experience) and a Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), Certified Information Privacy Manager (CIPM), Certified Information Privacy Technologist (CIPT), or equivalent privacy certification.

Experience working in a technology, software-as-a-service (SaaS), or online education environment.
Experience supporting privacy programs for artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning products.
Experience supporting compliance with additional global privacy laws, including APAC and Latin American privacy frameworks.
Experience defining and reporting operational metrics, KPIs, or dashboards for privacy programs.
Law degree or equivalent legal training.

Neu soll die JVA Witzwil rund 400 Vollzugsplätze in den Regimen offenen und geschlossenen Männervollzug, Untersuchungshaft sowie Administrativhaft anbieten. Damit würde das Konzept \ realisiert.

* Die zukünftigen Betriebsstrukturen (Gebäudetechnik, Facility Management, Unterhalt und Instandhaltung) inkl. Rollen, Prozessen, Ressourcen, Services und Einbezug von externen Anbietern unter dem Aspekt von zeitgemässen Arbeitsweisen unter Berücksichtigung der technologischen Möglichkeiten definieren
* Die verschiedenen Budgetpositionen bewirtschaften und ein Betriebsbudget erarbeiten
* Den dereinstigen Umzug von der heutigen JVA Thorberg in die neue JVA in Abstimmung mit den Nutzern planen und begleiten

Bereit für einen Job mit Sinn?

The Program Manager, Onboarding owns both delivery and governance within Maltego's customer onboarding program. You manage a portfolio of complex accounts from Sales handover to Customer Success handover, and simultaneously govern the playbooks, SOPs, and continuous improvement initiatives that allow the full onboarding team to deliver quality at scale. This role combines hands-on customer engagement with program-level leadership — you run accounts, and you design the systems others work within.
What to expect Onboarding Delivery
Manage a portfolio of complex, high-touch, and scale-touch accounts end-to-end, balancing delivery responsibilities with program governance work.
Design and execute onboarding plans for accounts with advanced technical or organizational requirements.
Deliver Customer Success handovers that consistently meet or exceed acceptance criteria, maintaining high CSAT across your portfolio.
Use insights from account work to identify patterns and inform program improvement.
Program Management
Design the playbooks and SOPs for Scale-touch and High-touch onboarding, maintaining accuracy and ensuring they reflect current best practice.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives: identifying inefficiencies, designing solutions, and driving rollout across the team.
Coordinate with Scaled and Digital Onboarding Managers to ensure program consistency across all onboarding formats.
Manage content accuracy as a program responsibility, working with Product to keep onboarding resources current after releases.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Build credibility with stakeholders through consistent delivery and clear communication.
Represent the program perspective in cross-functional meetings, contributing structured analysis and concrete recommendations.
Surface patterns from onboarding delivery into cross-team discussions, ensuring program feedback reaches the right people.
Customer Engagement
Serve as the primary customer contact for assigned accounts throughout the onboarding engagement.
Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.
Facilitate complex discovery conversations that surface strategic use cases and inform onboarding design.
Proactively address customer concerns before they become escalations.
Feedback, Reporting & Process Improvement
Synthesize feedback from accounts and program touchpoints into actionable recommendations for relevant teams.
Drive specific process improvement initiatives from identification through rollout, managing stakeholder alignment and change management.
Contribute to onboarding content and documentation improvements that scale across the full team.
Your profile in short Required
Proven track record managing complex customer onboarding or implementation engagements in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
Demonstrated experience owning program governance — playbooks, SOPs, or process frameworks used by other team members.
Strong project management skills with the ability to balance multiple concurrent engagements and program initiatives.
Excellent communication skills — able to calibrate messaging for customers, internal stakeholders, and senior leadership.
Comfortable working across systems and tools (CRM, project management, analytics platforms) to track progress and report outcomes.
Analytical mindset — able to identify patterns, synthesize feedback, and design evidence-based improvements.

Experience with OSINT, investigations, or intelligence workflows.
Familiarity with product-led or usage-driven customer success models.
Background in process improvement, change management, or operational excellence.

The Staff Technical Program Manager (TPM)- Devices resides within the Product and Technology organization and drives the end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-functional technical programs and strategic initiatives.

This role requires deep technical expertise, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence outcomes across a highly matrixed organization.

The TPM serves as the execution lead for hardware, firmware, software, and systems integration initiatives, ensuring product solutions are architected, implemented, and validated to meet requirements, schedules, and quality standards.

Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Operations teams, this leader drives alignment, mitigates risk, and delivers measurable business outcomes.

Lead complex technical programs spanning web, mobile, medical device, embedded software, firmware, and data platforms.
Drive end-to-end program execution from initiation through launch, ensuring stakeholder alignment across all milestones.
Coordinate cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Design, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Operations.
Manage technical dependencies, risks, issues, and mitigation plans across multiple concurrent workstreams.
Facilitate technical discussions regarding architecture decisions, systems integration, platform scalability, and design tradeoffs.
Partner with senior engineers and architects to align program execution with technical roadmap objectives and platform evolution.
Develop and maintain program dashboards, status reports, key performance indicators, and executive communications.
Apply Lean, Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and continuous improvement methodologies to deliver predictable outcomes.
Leverage AI-powered tools and automation to improve program reporting, risk identification, dashboard creation, and operational efficiency.
Establish and track program success metrics, ensuring measurable outcomes and transparent progress reporting.
Drive stakeholder communication, influence decision-making, and resolve blockers through collaboration and negotiation.
Conduct post-launch reviews and implement lessons learned to continuously improve delivery processes.
Mentor and develop junior Technical Program Managers, providing coaching on risk management, systems thinking, and program leadership.
Shape organizational processes and operating models while serving as a thought leader for the TPM function.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
8+ years ofexperienceTechnical Program Management.
Experience managing programs within healthcare technology, health and life sciences, medical devices, or other regulated industries.
Demonstrated experience delivering complex, cross-functional technical programs with measurable business outcomes.
Experience managing technical programs involving hardware, firmware, embedded software, systems integration, or cloud-based software platforms.
Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), APIs, CI/CD, DevOps, system integration, and security principles.
Experience using program management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Airtable, or similar platforms.
Proven ability to identify, manage, and mitigate program risks while balancing scope, schedule, cost, and quality.
Experience leveraging AI and automation tools to improve program management processes, reporting, and operational efficiency.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and influence skills with the ability to work effectively across all organizational levels.

Experience leading hardware, firmware, and regulated medical device development programs from concept through launch.
Familiarity with Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) methodologies.
Experience supporting consumer mobile platforms (iOS and/or Android).
Knowledge of AI/ML technologies, responsible AI principles, model governance, and compliance considerations.
Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent platforms.
Lean, Agile, or Scrum certifications including Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe Agilist (SA), Scrum Master (SSM), POPM, or equivalent certification.
Experience mentoring Technical Program Managers and leading TPM best practice initiatives.
Demonstrated expertise in enterprise systems architecture and large-scale platform integrations.
Experience driving organizational process improvements and operating model transformations.

The Project Manager, State and Local Government is a five-year, fixed-term position supported by a contract with the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA). Employment is expected to continue for up to five years, subject to continued program funding, organizational needs, and performance.
Reporting to the Vice President, State and Local Government within the U.S. Market Transformation & Development team, you will serve as the lead project manager for a five-year statewide initiative supporting annual cohorts of New York local governments as they develop and implement ambitious clean energy and decarbonization strategies.
You will oversee the full lifecycle of multiple annual cohorts, ensuring successful program planning, implementation, stakeholder engagement, technical assistance delivery, curriculum development, partner coordination, contract compliance, and continuous program improvement.

Working closely with NYSERDA, local governments, subject matter experts, regional partners, universities, and internal cross-functional teams, you will help communities translate climate goals into measurable actions while supporting scalable and replicable approaches to market transformation.
This position serves as the primary day-to-day contact for NYSERDA and is responsible for ensuring exceptional program execution, strategic alignment, and delivery of all contractual commitments while advancing equitable, resilient, and high-performance communities throughout New York State.

Lead the planning and execution of a five-year, multi-cohort statewide program, managing the full lifecycle of annual cohorts of New York local governments from recruitment and onboarding through implementation, reporting, and closeout.
Serve as the primary project manager and day-to-day liaison for NYSERDA, ensuring contract compliance, timely delivery of milestones, budget oversight, reporting, risk management, and fulfillment of all program deliverables.
Manage cross-functional teams and external partners, including subject matter experts, subcontractors, regional organizations, universities, USGBC Chapters, and local government stakeholders to ensure coordinated program delivery and an exceptional participant experience.
Develop and oversee cohort curriculum, technical assistance, and participant resources, including orientations, workshops, learning sessions, implementation guides, playbooks, and other educational materials that support local government decarbonization efforts.
Provide strategic guidance and technical support to participating local governments, facilitating workshops, office hours, peer learning, and one-on-one coaching to help communities develop and implement clean energy and climate action strategies.
Establish and maintain strong project governance practices, including project plans, schedules, budgets, risk logs, performance metrics, documentation, and continuous process improvements to ensure successful program execution.
Lead stakeholder engagement and external communications, representing USGBC at meetings, conferences, webinars, and public events while coordinating dissemination of best practices, lessons learned, and market transformation resources.
Supervise program staff, fellows, interns, and consultants, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high-quality execution while supporting the strategic goals of USGBC and NYSERDA.

Experience
Minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible project management experience supporting complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives.
Experience managing large-scale public sector, sustainability, climate, clean energy, environmental policy, or technical assistance programs.
Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, external partners, and government stakeholders.
Demonstrated experience managing project schedules, budgets, reporting, governance, and contract deliverables.
Experience working with state or local governments is strongly preferred.

Bachelor's degree in Public Administration, Sustainability, Environmental Policy, Project Management, Urban Planning, Environmental Science, or a related discipline. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will also be considered.
Technology/System(s)
Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, SharePoint, resource management platforms).
Comfort managing virtual convenings, shared workspaces, and collaborative platforms.
Skills
Exceptional project management, organization, and time‑management skills.
Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into accessible content for diverse audiences.
Skilled at anticipating challenges and proactively resolving issues.
High attention to detail; strong writing and facilitation skills.
Customer‑focused, collaborative, and committed to quality.
Experience facilitating workshops or training sessions.
Familiarity with decarbonization, clean energy, or building performance topics is a plus.
Familiarity with LEED and LEED for Cities certification frameworks is preferred.
Certifications
PMP, LEED GA, or LEED AP preferred; candidates in progress will be considered.

Maintain system health monitoring, managed maintenance, and as-built documentation for technology deployed outside the enterprise perimeter
Own decommissioning and transition of technology when properties or vehicles change, so nothing orphaned (access, data, or hardware) gets left behind
Act as first point of contact and triage for executive and family requests involving personal technology and security systems, resolving directly where you can and routing to the Protective Services Lead when it requires a broader architecture or strategy decision
Contribute audit-ready documentation for the technology under your ownership to support regulatory, customer, and partner diligence requests

Bring hands-on physical security technology experience from residential, travel, or personal-protection contexts, not only corporate/enterprise systems

Care about Anthropic's mission and the unique security considerations that come with building frontier AI systems

Die ADUplan Bauingenieure GmbH ist ein etabliertes und dynamisch wachsendes Bauingenieurunternehmen mit Standorten in Zürich und Kreuzlingen. Das Unternehmen steht für pragmatische, effiziente und lösungsorientierte Ingenieurdienstleistungen im Tief\- und Strassenbau und begleitet öffentliche Verwaltungen, Unternehmen sowie Privatpersonen in der Planung, Projektierung, Ausführung und Beratung von Infrastrukturanlagen.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine engagierte und motivierte Persönlichkeit als:
Projektleiter:in / Bauleiter:in Tief\- und Strassenbau
In dieser Funktion leiten und bearbeiten Sie anspruchsvolle Projekte im kantonalen und kommunalen Tief\- und Strassenbau – von der Konzeptentwicklung über die Projektierung und Realisierung bis zur erfolgreichen Abnahme.
Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehört zudem die Erstellung von technischen Berichten, Kostenvoranschlägen und Machbarkeitsstudien sowie die Ausarbeitung von Ausschreibungs\- und Offertunterlagen. Sie sind die direkte Ansprechperson für Bauherren, Behörden, Unternehmen und weitere Projektbeteiligte und koordinieren sämtliche Projektpartner.
Ihr Profil
Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium als Bauingenieur:in FH/ETH oder als Techniker:in HF und bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im allgemeinen Tiefbau mit.
Idealerweise verfügen Sie bereits über Berufserfahrung als Projektingenieur:in, Projektleiter:in oder Bauleiter:in im Tief\- und Strassenbau. Eine strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise zeichnet Sie ebenso aus wie Einsatzfreude und Durchsetzungsstärke. Sie treten kontaktfreudig, sicher und kundenorientiert auf und verstehen es, technische und organisatorische Aufgaben effizient miteinander zu verbinden.
Was Ihnen geboten wird
Es erwartet Sie eine abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem motivierten und kollegialen Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Zudem bieten wir Ihnen moderne Arbeitsbedingungen, flexible Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie gezielte Unterstützung bei Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.

Our Story
Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.
LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.
With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

## Description du poste ##
La direction des soins est à la recherche de son ou sa future responsable diététicienne pour manager et accompagner les équipes sur le site de Cluse-Roseraie dans leurs prestations dans différents départements médicaux. La patientèle peut être adulte comme pédiatrique notamment dans le domaine des soins aigus ainsi que pour l-enseignement thérapeutique au décours de la maladie chronique.
Vous dirigez une équipe d-environ 30 collaborateurs et collaboratrices. Vous organisez, coordonnez et supervisez leurs activités et prévoyez toute action nécessaire de développement des compétences individuelles comme collectives. Vous garantissez une circulation optimale des informations, qu-elle soit ascendante, descendante et/ ou transversale. Vous développez un climat de confiance dans l-équipe nécessaire au bien vivre et travailler ensemble dans le respect des valeurs institutionnelles.
Vous savez donner le cap et accompagner vos équipes pour atteindre des objectifs communs. Vous déclinez les axes stratégiques de votre métier en objectifs réalisables par l-équipe tout en veillant à la contribution individuelle de chaque membre.
En qualité de responsable d-équipe, vous êtes garante ou garant de la qualité des soins nutritionnels et promouvez toute mesure visant à optimiser et à améliorer les prestations offertes à la patientèle. Vous disposez d-indicateurs pour conduire l-amélioration continue de la qualité. Vous contribuez également au développement de nouvelles pratiques.
Votre esprit collaboratif vous permet de soutenir et développer l-interdisciplinarité entre tous les professionnelles et professionnels de la santé agissant sur la prise en charge des patientes et patients.
Vous gérez aisément la bonne allocation des ressources comme du matériel pour répondre aux besoins en soins des patients et patientes dans le cadre du budget alloué. Vous exercez également un rôle de référente ou référent pour les systèmes tarifaires en lien avec la profession
Selon les besoins, vous êtes amené ou amenée à recruter de nouvelles collaboratrices et collaborateurs et veillez au développement de leur expertise dans les champs de spécialité de chaque secteur tout en veillant à la polyvalence nécessaire des compétences

Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bachelor HES en nutrition et diététique ou d'un titre jugé équivalent, reconnu par la Croix-Rouge suisse.
Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée en management, acquise au travers d'au moins cinq années de pratique dans le domaine hospitalier. Une formation en management, telle qu'un CAS en management des institutions de santé, constitue un atout.
Dotée ou doté d'excellentes qualités relationnelles, vous faites preuve d'entregent et d'une communication positive. Vous savez fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs et instaurer un climat de collaboration propice au bon fonctionnement du service.
Ouvert ou ouverte au changement, vous êtes capable d'accompagner les évolutions de votre environnement professionnel avec pragmatisme. Vous savez également prendre du recul sur vos pratiques managériales afin de les faire évoluer de manière continue.
Vous êtes une personne reconnue pour votre sens de l'organisation, votre flexibilité et votre capacité à gérer les priorités, vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement où les activités sont variées et transversales.

Klaviyo's infrastructure is the foundation that every product, every customer, and every engineer depends on. In this role you will be the connective tissue between our Infrastructure organization and the rest of engineering, driving the rollout of critical, cross-cutting programs that affect how we build, operate, and secure our platform at scale.
You will juggle a high volume of parallel efforts across cloud infrastructure, FinOps, build systems, software migrations, security operations, and more, keeping each moving, supporting teams to be successful, and escalating quickly when capacity or priority decisions need to be made. This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do. It's a role for someone who drives.
How you'll make a difference
Own the rollout of infrastructure initiatives across engineering. Drive programs from planning through completion, coordinating across teams that don't report to you and don't always have capacity to prioritize infrastructure work. Keep things moving.
Manage a high volume of concurrent efforts. At any given time you'll be tracking security operations improvements, FinOps initiatives, build system changes, software migrations, and other cross-cutting infrastructure programs simultaneously. Clear prioritization and status visibility are non-negotiable.
Hold teams accountable and escalate when needed. You know how to build the relationships and create the visibility that keeps infrastructure work from getting deprioritized. When a team genuinely lacks capacity, you surface that quickly, bring the right people into the conversation, and get a trade-off decision made — not absorb the delay quietly.
Develop a way to provide program health continuously. Establish and maintain clear, actionable reporting on the status of all infrastructure rollouts. Leadership should always know what's on track, what's at risk, and what decisions are needed from them.
Partner with Infrastructure leadership on planning and prioritization. Work closely with engineering and SRE leadership to build and maintain a rolling roadmap, sequence work across teams, and ensure infrastructure investments align with engineering and business priorities.
Define clear ways of working across teams. Create frameworks, templates, and coordination models that make it easier for infrastructure and product engineering teams to work together effectively. Build the playbook as you go.
Develop deep technical fluency in the programs you own. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's being built, why it matters, and what the technical risks are well enough to ask the right questions, identify blockers early, and represent the work credibly to engineering leadership.
Drive automation and operational excellence. Challenge manual processes wherever you find them. Partner with infrastructure teams to identify opportunities to centralize and automate change rather than default to simply assigning out the same work to different teams.

Technically fluent. You've worked closely with infrastructure, SRE, or platform engineering teams. You understand security operations, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and software migrations well enough to engage substantively, not just track status.
A driver, not a facilitator. You move work forward. You follow up, push back, escalate, and hold people accountable, constructively, but consistently. You don't wait for the next meeting to surface a problem.
Influential and relationship-driven. You know that infrastructure work gets done through trust, not authority. You build strong relationships across engineering teams, understand what motivates different stakeholders, and use that context to create alignment
AI-first in how you work. You don't just talk about AI, you use it daily to move faster, work smarter, and do more with less. You bring that mindset to the teams you work with and actively look for opportunities to automate, accelerate, and improve how programs are run.
Comfortable with high volume and ambiguity. You can manage many parallel workstreams without losing track of any of them, and you don't need a clean problem statement to get started.
Clear and direct communicator. You tailor your message by audience, engineering teams need different information than engineering VPs, and you make it easy for leadership to understand status and make decisions quickly.
Outcome-oriented. You measure success by realizing the impact and what improves, not by the quality of your tracking.

8+ years of experience in technical program management within a fast-paced product engineering environment, ideally SaaS or high-growth tech.
Demonstrated experience driving large-scale infrastructure rollouts across multiple engineering teams.
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, FinOps, security operations, and software migration programs.
Strong fluency in tools such as Jira, Linear, Asana, or Smartsheet.
Track record of managing competing priorities and delivering results without direct authority over engineering teams.

Experience in both infrastructure and product engineering contexts.
Familiarity with FinOps frameworks and cloud cost optimization programs.
Experience building or evolving TPM practices in a nascent or growing function.
Hands-on with CI/CD tooling, build systems, or security compliance frameworks.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to lead two connected migration workstreams within a complex enterprise technology program. This is not a generic coordination role. You will provide hands-on delivery leadership across technically complex, security-sensitive migrations, creating clarity from partially defined requirements and driving the program through planning, dependency management, operational readiness, execution, and closure.
The role requires close coordination between business, engineering, security, identity, infrastructure, and enabling platform teams. You will be expected to challenge weak plans, surface risks early, drive decisions, and keep senior stakeholders aligned around facts, trade-offs, and clear next actions.
The two workstreams focus on reducing technology risk and modernizing access and identity capabilities. One involves migrating external users from unmanaged BYOD access toward managed devices or VDI-based access through AWS. The second involves migrating legacy identity configurations onto a standardized Entra ID setup within existing Active Directory environments.

translate the migration objectives into an executable program structure with clear workstreams, milestones, owners, assumptions, and success criteria,
define clear scope and accountability across engineering, security, identity, infrastructure, O365 administration, and business stakeholders,
create and maintain an integrated roadmap, identify the critical path, and highlight areas requiring additional staffing, technical decisions, or leadership support,
own the integrated delivery plan from current-state analysis through migration design, execution readiness, rollout, and closure,
coordinate participating teams and external contributors to ensure workstreams remain aligned and dependencies are actively managed,
ensure migrations include business readiness, stakeholder communications, cutover planning, fallback considerations, and post-migration validation,
maintain a transparent view of risks, actions, issues, dependencies, and decisions across the migration workstreams,
identify and escalate delivery blockers early, particularly around device strategy, regional rollout constraints, identity dependencies, tenant configuration, and capacity,
escalate issues with clear recommendations and drive them through to resolution,
establish lightweight but rigorous governance appropriate for a security-sensitive migration program,
maintain the integrated plan, RAID log, dependency map, decision log, stakeholder map, and executive status reporting,
establish migration-readiness checkpoints and ensure teams are prepared for controlled execution,
challenge technical plans and migration sequencing where hidden dependencies or delivery risks exist,
facilitate productive discussions between identity, endpoint, infrastructure, security, and engineering specialists,
translate technical constraints and dependencies into clear business and program implications,
provide concise, fact-based reporting to senior stakeholders, clearly distinguishing progress, risks, blockers, and required decisions,
ensure program governance remains focused on decision-making and delivery discipline rather than unnecessary administrative overhead,

extensive experience in Technical Project Management, Technical Program Management, or similar delivery leadership roles,
proven experience leading complex, multi-team migration or transformation programs,
experience delivering initiatives involving identity, access, endpoint, infrastructure, cloud, or platform migrations,
practical understanding of technologies such as Entra ID, Active Directory, O365, AWS, VDI, or adjacent enterprise technology ecosystems,
experience managing programs that combine technical migration work with stakeholder management, operational readiness, and controlled rollout,
ability to work credibly with senior engineers, architects, security specialists, business stakeholders, and external vendors,

We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Marketing Project Manager to build the operating system for our paid media team, and then run it.
Sweat Pants Agency manages around 57 brands and spends between $5M and $10M a month across Meta, Google, TikTok, and AppLovin. We're the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands from zero. Our average client stays with us for over three years.
Our email and SMS side is exceptionally well run. Project management there is tight, the templates exist, the dashboards are live, and nothing slips. Our paid media side is not there yet, and that's the job. This role is paid media only, so you won't be splitting your attention across two teams.
Roughly 25 to 30 accounts sit on the paid media side and are yours to keep in order. You'd be the first person in this seat, which means you're not inheriting a process. You're designing one.
The first things you'd own
We think in rocks, meaning the things that need pushing uphill. Here are ours, in priority order.
1. Capacity planning. Right now we don't have a real model for who is working on what, how loaded they are, or what happens when a new account lands. You'd build it: a live view of capacity across media buyers, designers, and video editors, with the ability to see an overload coming two weeks out instead of the day someone misses a deadline.
2. Creative workflow and process. Creative is our biggest bottleneck and it's cross functional. It spans our graphic design team, our video editors, and our media buyers who double as creative strategists. There's no single pipeline from request to delivery right now. You'd build it, run it, and be the person who guarantees we hit the creative volumes we owe clients every month.
3. Creators and UGC. We source creators constantly and there's no system behind it. You'd own sourcing across Billo, Backstage, email, and wherever else the right person is. That means negotiating rates and turnaround, tracking orders, managing usage rights so we never run an ad we've lost the rights to, tracking costs per account, and making sure markups land correctly on client invoices. If you haven't done this before, you should be genuinely comfortable asking a stranger for a better rate.
4. Client onboarding. We have a process and it needs refining, by someone who does this for a living rather than by me. Account access collection (Meta Business Manager, Google Ads, Klaviyo, Shopify, TikTok), ClickUp setup, reporting and dashboard configuration, so every launch feels identical.
What you'd do day to day
Run ClickUp as the single source of truth. Build and maintain templates, recurring tasks, intake forms, automations, and dashboards. Every account has a current status and a named owner, always.
Own capacity planning across the paid media team and flag overload before it becomes a missed deliverable.
Track every creative deliverable from request to delivery, including revisions and approvals, and QA the work before it reaches a client.
Source, negotiate with, and manage creators. Track orders, usage rights, and costs.
Own client onboarding end to end and standardize it so every launch runs the same way.
Build landing pages and advertorials using Claude Code from time to time.
Make sure client reporting and dashboards are set up correctly and stay accurate for every account.
Build internal tools, automations, and living SOPs using AI so the whole team runs faster and the same way every time.
Catch gaps in communication and delivery before they escalate, and drive follow ups to closure.
Schedule and coordinate recurring client and internal meetings, capture action items, and make sure they actually get done.
Flag at risk accounts early and escalate.
About the landing pages
We don't sell landing pages as a service. We build them anyway, because a weak page is the most common reason good creative doesn't convert, and waiting on a client's dev team costs us weeks.
Our media buyers already build pages this way. You'd do the same: advertorials, presell pages, and landing page variants built with Claude Code off existing templates and shipped to Shopify or the client's stack. You don't need to be an engineer and you won't be architecting anything from scratch. You need to be someone who can take a brief, work with AI to build the page, QA it, and ship it, and who finds that interesting rather than terrifying.
How we work, and please read this part carefully
This is the part most job posts leave out, and it's the part that actually determines whether you'd be happy here.
We give a lot of autonomy and we mean it. Nobody here is on a time clock and nobody ever will be. If I have to think about what you're doing with your hours, we've already lost. I judge outcomes, not activity.
The flip side is that I'm not a gatekeeper. One of the biggest red flags for me is someone who asks a lot of permission questions. Can I change this, should I do that. No. Just do it and show me. If you need a company card to solve something, you'll have one. You have full trust on day one. It's only ever lost, never earned.
Ownership is the thing we care about most. "That wasn't my role" is a disqualifier here. If creative is the bottleneck on an account, you go fix creative, whether or not it was in your scope. We've all done work outside our lane to get the result.
We judge the first 30 days harshly. We're looking for you to take action early and show that you're self directed. We usually know quickly, and it rarely turns around. What I can tell you is that people who make it past that point almost never leave. Our team retention is exceptional.
Mistakes are fine. Patterns aren't. You'll never hear me raise my voice. When something breaks we look at the process, not the person. My Slack tagline is "everything's my fault." But if the same thing breaks repeatedly, that's a fit problem.
My job is to protect the team. We have let go of clients for being unkind to our people and we'll do it again. I ask you to put clients first, and if there's ever a problem, tell me, because I'll put you first.
I like being wrong. Tell me there's a better way. Nothing here is sacred and everything can change.
Where this goes
On our email side, project management became the pipeline into strategy. Several of our email strategists started as PMs. We're building the same path on paid media. If you want to end up as a media buyer or creative strategist, this is the seat that gets you there, and you'll get your hands dirty along the way, writing creative briefs, launching ads, and sitting in on account reviews.
If you'd rather stay in operations and own this function as it grows, that works too. Tell us which one you want.
Our mission is simple: be the no BS agency partner you love working with.

Skills
Elite organization and follow through. You close loops without being chased.
You build project management systems, you don't just work inside them. Hands on experience standing up or substantially rebuilding a system in ClickUp, Asana, or Monday, including spaces, custom fields, templates, statuses, intake, automations, and dashboards. This is a fixed term contract for an ASAP start until May 2027. We are looking for an experienced hands-on Senior Localisation Program Manager to own and optimise Product localisation.
Localisation efforts at Klaviyo are centred around linguistic excellence, teamwork and scale. We are responsible for the translation and cultural adaptation of all customer-facing content from performance-based marketing collateral to original training programs, the Klaviyo application and website, and our partner and developer portals.

Our work is not just about translation and localization; it is about providing our customers with high quality localization and an experience that feels locally relevant and fuels international growth for both our customers and Klaviyo. Your primary responsibilities will be to:
Manage all localisation for Product, Help Centre and Customer Education , partnering closely with those teams to deliver high quality, locally relevant experiences across all supported languages.
Manage all language contractors (including freelance linguists, agencies and other language vendors), ensuring we have the right resourcing, quality, cost and workflows in place to support current and future localisation needs.
Contribute to scaling localisation overall , including the management of machine translation for all languages and helping to build an AI-first translation platform that enables faster, more scalable and more cost-effective localisation for Klaviyo.

End-to-end localisation ownership for Product, Help Centre and Customer Education : Plan, execute and manage localisation solutions for the Klaviyo Product, Help Centre and Customer Education teams, partnering closely with those teams to fully understand business goals, priorities and opportunities.
Contractor and vendor management : Source, onboard, train, develop and manage a highly effective network of linguists and language partners (including freelancers, agencies and other vendors) that consistently deliver high-quality output across all languages and content types.
Language quality management : Define clear expectations and quality standards for all languages, set up scalable review and feedback loops, and manage performance to ensure we meet or exceed quality, timeliness and cost targets. Own and manage the Klaviyo Language hub (language governance) and associated processes across all languages.
TMS and MT ownership : Own and manage our TMS (Smartling) as it relates to Product, Help Centre and Customer Education, ensuring optimisation for different content types, CMSs, language assets and resources, and integrating and managing machine translation within our workflows for all supported languages.
AI-first translation platform : Partner with Engineering, Product, Data and other internal teams to help design and build an AI-first translation platform that leverages MT, generative AI and automation to increase localisation speed, consistency and scalability while maintaining quality.
Transform workflows by putting AI at the centre, building smarter systems and ways of working from the ground up.
Collaboration across the Localisation team : Collaborate with the broader Localisation team to deliver a high-quality localised experience for international customers, drive scale in localisation, and resolve issues and blockers quickly.
Champion the international customer : Be a champion internally for the international Klaviyo customer, ensuring their needs are represented in content, product decisions and localisation priorities.

Deep understanding of localisation concepts, methodologies, tools and assets, and demonstrated experience of designing and implementing localisation solutions at scale, including hands-on experience with TMS and MT/ AI-driven workflows
Experience leading product localisation across multiple languages
Ability to to partner with internal teams and influence roadmaps to ensure localisation is embedded early and effectively
Ability to hold self, teams and contractors accountable to a high quality standard

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by at least one of the following: 1.

Related Curriculum: Degree in architectural engineering may be accepted as satisfying in full the basic requirements, provided the completed course work in architectural engineering provided knowledge, skills, and abilities substantially equivalent to those provided in the courses specified in paragraph A.

The curriculum for a degree in either architecture or architectural engineering covers function, esthetics, site, structure, economics, mechanical-electrical, and other engineering problems related to the design and construction of buildings primarily (but not exclusively) intended to house human activities.

The courses required for a degree in architecture generally place emphasis upon planning, esthetics, and materials and methods of construction, while the courses for an architectural engineering degree place equal or greater weight on the technical engineering aspects such as structural systems, mechanical systems, and the properties of materials.

Because of this difference in emphasis, persons with degrees in architecture may have a preference for work assignments that offer greater opportunities for them to express their artistic and creative abilities.

As a result, they may be more concerned with planning and design aspects of architecture, and persons with degrees in architectural engineering may be more engaged in aspects emphasizing technical engineering considerations. 2.

Experience: An applicant lacking a degree in architecture must have had l year of experience in an architect's office or in architectural work for each year short of graduation from a program of study in architecture. In the absence of college courses, 5 years of such experience is required.

Du koordinierst interne Fachteams wie Engineering, Automation, AVOR, Produktion, Montage und Qualifizierung sowie externe Partner und Lieferanten.Während der gesamten Realisierungsphase bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für Kunden in technischen, terminlichen und kommerziellen Fragen.
Du stellst sicher, dass Projektziele in Bezug auf Budget, Termine, Qualität, GMP\-Compliance und Dokumentation erreicht werden.
Du steuerst Projekt\-Reviews sowie Risiko\- und Änderungsmanagement und verfolgst offene Punkte konsequent bis zum Projektabschluss.
Du begleitest FAT, SAT, Inbetriebnahmen und Übergaben und unterstützt bei Qualifizierungsaktivitäten.
Du bist bereit, innerhalb der Schweiz zu reisen und bei Bedarf projektbezogen auch international im Einsatz zu sein.
Dein Profil
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes technisches Ingenieurstudium, zum Beispiel in Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen, Elektrotechnik oder Automation, oder bringst eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit.
Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Projektleitung im Anlagenbau, idealerweise im Pharma\-, Biotech\-, GMP\- oder Clean\-Utilities\-Umfeld.
Du bringst ein gutes technisches Verständnis für Wasseraufbereitung, Rohrleitungsbau, Automation und pharmazeutische Dokumentationsanforderungen mit.
Erfahrungen in GMP\-konformer Projektabwicklung, Qualifizierung, FAT/SAT, technischer Dokumentation sowie strukturiertem Abweichungsmanagement ist von Vorteil.
Du kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch; ösischkenntnisse sind ein zusätzliches Plus.
Du trittst sicher auf, denkst kundenorientiert und überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Kommunikations\-, Organisations\- und Moderationsfähigkeiten.
Du arbeitest selbständig, präzise, lösungsorientiert und belastbar – und hast Freude daran, komplexe Projekte erfolgreich voranzubringen.
Wir bieten dir
Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Eigenverantwortung in einem wachsenden Marktumfeld.
Die Mitarbeit an anspruchsvollen Pharmawasser\-Projekten mit hoher technischer Relevanz und klarer GMP\-Ausrichtung.
