Qui sommes\-nous ?
Alpenda est un acteur de référence de la construction en Suisse romande depuis plus de 100 ans.

Forte de près de 200 collaborateurs, l'entreprise accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de construction et de rénovation grâce à une approche globale couvrant la conception, la planification, la réalisation et la modernisation des bâtiments, avec une attention particulière portée à la qualité, à l'innovation et à la durabilité.

Filiale suisse du groupe DEMATHIEU BARD, Alpenda poursuit le développement de projets d'envergure. Ce lien renforce les synergies et les expertises des deux entreprises tout en préservant l'identité, la proximité et l'ancrage local qui font la force d'Alpenda.

Vous rejoignez la Direction Exploitation, en charge du pilotage des chantiers de l'ensemble des projets d'Alpenda. Sa mission est de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence en matière de qualité, de sécurité, de respect de l'environnement, ainsi que de maîtrise des délais et des budgets.

Nos équipes spécialisées interviennent sur des projets variés, en construction neuve comme en rénovation, dans les secteurs résidentiel et fonctionnel.

Reconnus pour notre expertise dans la réalisation de projets haut de gamme, nous accordons une importance particulière à l'accompagnement de nos clients, à la transparence de nos échanges et à l'excellence de nos prestations. En tant que Chef de Projet, vous assurez la gestion technique et le bon déroulement du projet.

Vous veillez également à la bonne représentation de l’entreprise et êtes un véritable leader de terrain, reconnu pour votre polyvalence et votre capacité à fédérer les différents intervenants.
Chef de projet H/F

Vous organisez, encadrez et accompagnez les équipes affectées au projet
Vous assurez la planification générale et le pilotage des travaux dans le respect des objectifs fixés.
Vous participez aux séances de projet avec le Maître d’Ouvrage et assurez le suivi des décisions ainsi que de la documentation associée
Vous entretenez et développez les relations avec le Maître d’Ouvrage, les mandataires, les entreprises et les autorités
Vous analysez les appels d’offres, comparez les soumissions et pilotez le processus d’adjudication. Vous accompagnez les équipes dans les négociations avec les entreprises et les partenaires
Vous supervisez l’établissement des contrats, des avenants et des documents contractuels
Vous assurez le suivi financier du projet, notamment la gestion budgétaire, le contrôle des coûts, la validation des situations de paiement et l’établissement du décompte final
Pourquoi pas vous ?
Vous avez obtenu un diplôme d’architecte ETS, HES ou EPF, de dessinateur en bâtiment ou en génie civil, d’ingénieur du bâtiment ou un titre jugé équivalent ?
Vous avez bénéficié d’une formation dans la conduite de travaux ou la gestion de projet ?
Vous justifiez d’au minimum 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Chef de Projet, idéalement au sein d’une Entreprise Totale ou Générale ?
Vous bénéficiez d’une première expérience réussie en Suisse dans une fonction similaire ?
Vous possédez de solides connaissances techniques, financières, de planification et de contrôle qualité acquises au travers de vos expériences ?
Votre capacité à fédérer, coordonner et accompagner les équipes est reconnue ?
Votre expérience en gestion contractuelle, en négociation avec les entreprises et partenaires, ainsi qu’en pilotage des appels d’offres constitue un véritable atout ?
Vous êtes prêt à vous investir dans ce projet situé dans le canton du Valais ?

Notre vision est d’accompagner nos clients dans une offre 100% locale de prestations durables et intelligentes dans l’énergie, le multimédia, la mobilité et les services aux communes.
Si vous aussi, vos actions quotidiennes en faveur de vos clients et de votre région sont guidées par des valeurs fortes, et que vous voulez participer à la transition énergétique et digitale, afin de répondre à la croissance constante et aux défis passionnants qui nous attendent, rejoignez\-nous !

Bist das Du?
Du willst mehr als Vorschriften umsetzen? Du möchtest Projekte aktiv mitgestalten, Verantwortung übernehmen und mit Deiner Expertise nachhaltige Lösungen schaffen? Bei uns übernimmst Du eine Schlüsselrolle in anspruchsvollen Bauprojekten und verantwortest den Brandschutz von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.
Dich erwarten komplexe Mandate, viel Eigenverantwortung und direkter Einfluss auf wichtige Entscheidungen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, berätst Bauherrschaften und Projektteams auf Augenhöhe und entwickelst praxisnahe Brandschutzlösungen mit hoher fachlicher Qualität.
Ob Strategie, Konzeption, Projektleitung oder Qualitätssicherung...
Du bringst Dein Know\-how dort ein, wo es sichtbar Wirkung erzielt. Dabei bewegst Du Dich in einem spannenden Umfeld aus Technik, Architektur und Projektmanagement und gestaltest sichere, zukunftsorientierte Gebäude aktiv mit.
Wenn Du Verantwortung schätzt, gerne vernetzt denkst und anspruchsvolle Projekte erfolgreich zum Ziel führst, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.
Das erwartet Dich
Du entwickelst und verantwortest Brandschutzkonzepte für unterschiedlichste Bauprojekte.
Du identifizierst Risiken, leitest Massnahmen ab und stellst deren Umsetzung sicher.
Du planst, koordinierst und begleitest Integraltests.
Du sicherst die Qualität im baulichen, technischen und organisatorischen Brandschutz.
Du berätst und unterstützt unsere Kunden im betrieblichen Brandschutz entlang des gesamten Lebenszyklus: von der Implementierung bis zur nachhaltigen Sicherstellung des Betriebs.
Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Auftraggebende, Behörden und Projektbeteiligte.
Du führst und steuerst Projekte und Mandate mit operativer Gesamtverantwortung.
Du übernimmst Beratungsmandate, Gesamtprojektleitungen sowie Bauherrenvertretungen.
Du koordinierst und führst interne sowie externe Planungsteams in der Rolle des QS Verantwortlichen
Das bringst Du mit
Du verfügst mindestens über den Fachausweis Fachperson Brandmeldeanlagen VKF und bist bereit, dich weiterzubilden. Idealerweise verfügst du bereits über eine Qualifikation als Brandschutzfachperson VKF oder Brandschutzexpert:in VKF.

Du verfügst über fundiertes brandschutztechnisches Know\-how.\[MB1\]
Du arbeitest strukturiert, organisierst, selbständig, effizient und behältst auch in komplexen Projekten den Überblick.
Du besitzt sehr gute Excel\-Kenntnisse; CAD\-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil.
Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf ösisch und verfügst über fundiertes Fachwissen in Deutsch.
Du besitzt einen Führerausweis Kategorie B sowie einen einwandfreien Leumund.
Du bist bereit, mindestens einmal pro Woche am Standort Schönbühl zu arbeiten.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

This role exists to fundamentally change how Cloudflare's marketing organization works by putting AI at the center of how we operate. Equal parts strategist and force-multiplier, you will identify where AI can deliver the greatest business impact, build the solutions that matter most, and systematically raise the organization's ability to build and leverage AI independently. The ultimate measure of success is not how much you build—it's how much the organization can build without you.

Drive and Build Marketing AI Strategy & High-Impact Integrated Programs
Define and own the marketing AI roadmap: assess where AI can deliver the greatest business impact, prioritize against marketing's strategic objectives, and sequence what gets tackled and in what order.
Build the business case for AI investments—not in abstract terms, but by mapping current-state workflows, quantifying the opportunity, and defining clear success metrics before work begins.
Directly build and ship AI solutions for the highest-impact, cross-functional opportunities—the programs that fundamentally reshape how marketing operates, not incremental automations.
Manage intake of AI requests from across the org. Triage what rises to the level of a strategic program versus what should be solved by the team closest to the problem with the right guidance and tools.
Scale the Marketing Organization's AI Capability
Build and run a champion network across marketing sub-teams: identify AI-curious practitioners, equip them with tools and patterns, and create the peer community that extends your reach.
Ensure every team has a clear path to surface AI needs—and a clear understanding that the goal is to help them build, not to build for them. When a request is triaged as self-serve, provide the guidance and support to make that successful.
Create the rituals that make AI visible and accessible: office hours, demo sessions, shared skill libraries, onboarding materials. Lower the barrier to entry so that building with AI becomes a normal part of how marketers work.
Establish reusable patterns and templates so that solutions built for one team can be adapted by others without starting from scratch.
Crossfunctional Planning and Integration
Serve as a core member of the Global Integrated Marketing Leadership team — helping set the strategic agenda, shaping priorities, and bringing structured thinking and a steady hand to the organization's biggest decisions and most ambiguous problems.
Translate and represent the leadership vision into a clear, coherent strategy for the Global Integrated Marketing organization, framing the hardest problems, developing options and recommendations, and helping leadership decide where to focus and where to place its biggest bets.
Design and run the operating system for the Global Integrated Marketing organization ensuring decisions happen on schedule and alignment is built in, not chased.
Create processes to monitor business performance and outcomes with proactive escalations to ensure demand gen goals are met for the Americas and globally.
What This Requires
8+ years in an integrated marketing role such as Marketing Operations, Demand Gen or a Marketing CoS function
Deep knowledge of how B2B marketing organizations operate—campaigns, content, demand gen, field marketing, analytics. You know where work gets stuck because you've lived it.
Comfort building with AI tools: agents, skills, prompt engineering, MCP integrations, no-code/low-code platforms.
A product management mindset: you think in terms of intake, backlog, iteration, adoption, and measurable outcomes.
Strong communication and the credibility to tell senior stakeholders "not yet" on low-priority requests and "think bigger" when teams default to automating the status quo.
Exceptional executive communication and writing skills — clear, concise, transparent, and insightful for teams, executives, and a diverse set of stakeholders.
What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Support core GTM leadership by managing Reddit's largest OPEX planning cycles, overseeing complex roadmaps, and ensuring decision-ready documents are prepared for monthly engagements with executive leadership, including the CRO and COO.

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to join our product team. The Technical Project Manager is responsible for driving the successful execution of technical projects and initiatives, from planning through delivery.

They work closely with Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to translate business and product priorities into actionable engineering plans, ensuring development resources are focused on the highest-priority initiatives.

The Technical Project Manager maintains project visibility, manages dependencies and timelines, identifies and resolves blockers, and proactively surfaces risks to stakeholders.

They also work directly with external partners and stakeholders to understand requirements, coordinate technical deliverables, and ensure successful execution across organizational boundaries.

The Technical Project Manager facilitates technical discussions and decision-making, adapting project plans as priorities shift to ensure teams remain aligned and projects are delivered effectively. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.
This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

Technical Project Management
Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate roadmap priorities into executable engineering plans and ensure development resources are aligned to the highest-priority initiatives.
Lead the planning and execution of technical projects across the software development life cycle, from requirements through deployment.
Develop and maintain project timelines, milestones, and delivery plans, adjusting priorities and plans as business and technical needs evolve.
Track dependencies across multiple engineering workstreams and proactively identify and resolve conflicts or blockers.
Coordinate releases and technical initiatives across web, mobile, API, backend, and other engineering teams.
Monitor project health using quantitative metrics and qualitative signals, surfacing risks and opportunities to leadership early.
Maintain project documentation and visibility to ensure stakeholders have a clear understanding of project status, decisions, risks, and next steps.
Engineering Collaboration
Work closely with engineers and engineering leaders to unblock teams, facilitate decision-making, and ensure technical work remains aligned with product and business priorities.
Facilitate technical discussions and drive clarity and alignment when teams encounter complex decisions or competing priorities.
Coordinate sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and other project ceremonies to support effective engineering execution.
Understand the software development life cycle and technical dependencies well enough to identify potential risks and help teams navigate challenges.
Adapt project management processes and methodologies to maximize team productivity and effectiveness in a fast-moving environment.
External Partner & Stakeholder Management
Serve as a key technical point of contact for external partners, customers, and other stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout project execution.
Gather and translate external partner requirements into actionable technical requirements, project plans, and priorities for internal teams.
Coordinate technical deliverables, integrations, timelines, and dependencies across internal engineering teams and external organizations.
Manage competing priorities and expectations across internal and external stakeholders, proactively identifying tradeoffs and escalating issues when needed.
Build strong relationships with external partners and stakeholders to facilitate collaboration, resolve issues, and ensure successful delivery of technical initiatives.
Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and technical decisions to external stakeholders in a clear and accessible manner.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and other cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
Translate technical information and project status into clear, actionable updates for non-technical stakeholders.
Partner with Product Management to understand business and user priorities and ensure engineering execution supports broader product strategy.
Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, resource allocation, and project execution.

5+ years of technical project management experience, ideally in a high-velocity technology or startup environment.
Strong understanding of the software development life cycle, from requirements gathering through deployment.
Experience coordinating complex projects across multiple engineering teams, technical workstreams, and external stakeholders.
Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proactive problem-solver who identifies risks, dependencies, and blockers before they impact project delivery.
Collaborative leader who builds trust through strong judgment, accountability, and follow-through.
Comfortable participating in technical discussions and working closely with engineers and engineering leadership.
Experience managing external partners, vendors, customers, or other stakeholders through complex technical projects.
Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and the ability to adapt processes based on team and project needs.

Healthcare experience, particularly in regulated environments.
Experience working with healthcare providers, payers, EHRs, or other healthcare technology partners.
Familiarity with HIPAA compliance requirements and healthcare software development.
Experience with API, platform, or backend engineering projects.

Service Delivery is the backbone of ServiceNow's customer success strategy in the Americas. We manage the governance, performance, and strategic alignment of our global system integrator (SI) and service delivery partners ensuring that partner-delivered services meet the highest standards of quality, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.

The Service Delivery function spans partner capacity planning, contingent worker onboarding, contract management, resource optimization, and end-to-end delivery governance across a large ecosystem of delivery partners serving thousands of customers.
As a Service Delivery Manager, you will be part of a team supporting the Director, Service Delivery in executing the regional service delivery strategy and governance frameworks. Your focus will be on the tactical, day-to-day oversight and governance of assigned partner engagements, ensuring consistent execution of ServiceNow standards, quality metrics, and customer outcomes.

The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing the performance, quality, and operational health of assigned partners. Acting as the primary governance point between ServiceNow and delivery partner(s) for your assigned portfolio, you ensure partner resources assigned to ServiceNow engagements are delivered in accordance with agreed service levels, quality standards, contractual commitments, and customer outcome expectations.
You monitor service delivery performance, identify risks, drive corrective actions, manage escalations, and provide ongoing visibility into delivery health for leadership.

Your role serves as the critical accountability layer that makes partner performance predictable, scalable, and aligned to ServiceNow standards across your assigned partners, regardless of whether they are delivering managed services, outsourced operations, subcontracted services, or project-based engagements.

You work closely with the Director, Service Delivery to implement governance processes, contribute to strategic initiatives, and escalate systemic issues that require regional leadership attention.

Partner Performance Governance
Serve as the primary ServiceNow point of contact for assigned partner points of contact; maintaining day-to-day oversight of partner service performance against contracted KPIs and SLAs.
Monitor service delivery performance across assigned partners, tracking key metrics including quality scores, customer satisfaction, utilization rates, delivery timelines, and cost-per-outcome performance; ensuring that ServiceNow and its customers are getting excellence in delivery from its partner resources.
Review delivery quality trends, audit findings, and operational metrics to identify systemic issues, root causes, and opportunities for continuous improvement within assigned portfolio.
Monitor delivery unit economics and cost-per-outcome performance, ensuring the contracted commercial model (unit-based, outcome-based, or hybrid) tracks to delivered value and flag discrepancies.
Maintain a dashboard or reporting view of assigned partner health metrics and escalate systemic issues to the Director, Service Delivery for strategic resolution or cross-regional alignment.
Escalation & Corrective Action
Lead delivery escalations across ServiceNow and partner teams for assigned engagements, driving timely issue resolution and ensuring accountability for remediation plans and service recovery activities.
Document escalation history, track resolution status, and report escalation trends to the Director, Service Delivery and relevant stakeholders.
Identify patterns in escalations across assigned partners and recommend process improvements or capability enhancements to the Director.
Partner with customer success teams and account teams to protect customer outcomes and address service delivery risks impacting customer health.
Onboarding & Service Transitions
Own tracking and acceptance of transition and mobilization milestones during partner onboarding or service transitions, including staffing ramp against plan, capability/certification readiness, and transition exit criteria.
Ensure partner resource skills and certifications align with service demands and customer requirements, tracking ongoing development and readiness.
Communicate onboarding milestones and status to leadership and document lessons learned from transitions.
Support the Director in partner capacity planning by tracking staffing ramps, utilization, and capability readiness for assigned partners.
Operational Governance & Reporting
Manage the operational governance cadence for assigned partners, including weekly performance check-ins, monthly reviews, and quarterly business review preparation.
Own capacity and demand management processes for assigned partners, including utilization tracking, variance planning, and periodic reconciliation against contracted volumes.
Manage the change control process for operational or initiative requests that have contractual implications, engaging Commercial Management as needed.
Flag discrepancies between service delivery status and invoicing or milestone payment triggers to Commercial and Finance stakeholders.
Produce and maintain performance reporting for assigned partners, providing regular updates to the Director and internal leadership stakeholders.
Identify and implement process improvements in response to changes in tooling, operating model, or service delivery requirements.
Collaboration & Coordination
Coordinate with other Service Delivery Managers in the region and across geographies on initiative design, sequencing, and rollout to ensure consistency.
Maintain regular interlock with the Global Partnerships and Channels (GPC) team, ensuring partner performance insights, escalations, and capability needs are escalated appropriately.
Support the Director in implementing regional governance frameworks and standard operating procedures across partner-delivered services.
Contribute to cross-functional initiatives with Commercial Management, Finance, Sales, and Customer Excellence Group to support partner relationship development.
Core Experience
5+ years of experience in service delivery management, vendor governance, partner performance management, or a related operational role within a global technology or SaaS environment.
Demonstrated experience managing partner, vendor, or supplier performance through structured governance frameworks, scorecards, and business reviews.
Proven ability to manage third-party performance against defined SLAs and KPIs, including escalation and corrective action processes.
Experience managing partners in a Customer Success and Professional Services delivery context.
Track record of driving continuous improvement and service efficiencies in partner or vendor management environments.
Operational & Functional Skills
Experience designing and maintaining operational documentation, including playbooks and standard operating procedures.
Strong project and program management capability, with a track record of delivering cross-functional initiatives to agreed timelines.
